description: An authz-policy artifact declares the complete authorization model for a feature: roles, resources, actions, effects, and the conditions under which access is granted.

rules.description: The policy must identify the feature it covers.
The roles array must declare at least one role.
The rules array must contain at least one rule.
Each rule must declare: id, subject, resource, action, and effect.
The policy must declare default_effect: 'deny' at the top level, or include a wildcard deny rule. Authorization is deny-by-default.
Allow rules must not use wildcard ('*', 'all', 'any') for both resource and action simultaneously.
Unauthenticated or anonymous subjects must not be granted admin-tier actions (delete, create, manage, configure) in any allow rule.
When multi_tenant: true, allow rules on tenant-scoped resources must include a condition checking tenant_id or org_id.
Machine-to-machine service roles must not inherit permissions from human user roles.
Roles named admin, super-admin, administrator, root, or owner must declare requires_mfa: true.
